purpose: Adapt explicit host navigation requests to an unsaved-change confirmation with a bounded browser unload warning.
behaviorProvider: Native React composition with existing shared Aegis controls; see explicit component and host responsibilities.

host: routing every guarded transition through the adapter
route failure presentation outside a dirty confirmation

requirements.statement: Expose requestNavigation(callback) from both the hook and render-prop component. A clean request runs without a dialog; a dirty request opens shared ConfirmDialog.
Call requestNavigation for every transition that should be guarded. The adapter does not intercept ordinary links, history APIs, browser back, or arbitrary SPA routers.
Accept one outstanding transition at a time. Concurrent requests resolve false rather than replacing the destination awaiting confirmation.
Cancel/dismiss resolves the pending request false without invoking its navigation callback. Unmount also settles an outstanding request false.
After confirmation, await onDiscard when still dirty, then invoke the stored navigation callback. Resolve true only after that callback completes.

For a confirmed guarded transition, thrown discard/navigation errors remain in ConfirmDialog and retain the same request for retry. A clean navigation rejection resolves false; the host owns its error presentation.
Attach beforeunload only while dirty and beforeUnload is enabled, and remove it when those conditions end or the component unmounts.
Treat beforeunload as a best-effort browser prompt: text, availability and user-activation requirements are browser-controlled. Persist or recover drafts independently when needed.
Make discard/navigation retry-safe and handle irreversible side effects; unmount stops subsequent work but cannot undo a navigation callback already running.
Use the shared ConfirmDialog for names, keyboard dismissal and focus return. Owned wrapper geometry uses workflow tokens.

limitations: No universal interception of router events, browser history or links.
Browser unload prompts may be suppressed and cannot show custom application text reliably.
An already running callback cannot be canceled or undone by unmount.
A retry may invoke onDiscard again; host callbacks must tolerate retries.
